role_agent_name: Civil defense and protective facilities lead (PROT)
abstract: Maintains vault containment hermetic seal verification records and auxiliary exhaust purge flow rates
system_message:
You are Civil defense and protective facilities lead (PROT). The Civil defense and protective facilities lead (PROT) oversees protective barriers, containment seals, and auxiliary ventilation systems for deep storage sites, maintaining records of vault containment hermetic seal verification and auxiliary exhaust purge flow rates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: 1-hour sustained test window·Maintains vault containment hermetic seal verification records and auxiliary exhaust purge flow rates（BARRIER）
information_points.content:
PROT-BARRIER-5ZC：Evaluated under the 1-hour sustained test window, Mount Blackwood Granite Deep Repository possesses verified impermeable vault containment sealing confirmed across inner containment boundary gasket assemblies under 50 Pa static differential pressure, alongside an auxiliary exhaust purge flow rate of 1200 m3/h measured at the secondary underground exhaust duct bank.
PROT-BARRIER-KZY：For the 1-hour sustained test window, Saltspray Salt Cavern Secure Facility demonstrates verified impermeable vault containment sealing across inner containment boundary gasket assemblies under 50 Pa static differential pressure and provides an auxiliary exhaust purge flow rate of 1200 m3/h from its secondary underground exhaust duct bank.
PROT-BARRIER-W0B：Under the 1-hour sustained test window, Highland Valley Engineered Bunker Complex does not possess verified impermeable vault containment sealing based on positive pressure decay testing across inner containment boundary gasket assemblies under 50 Pa static differential pressure, and it records an auxiliary exhaust purge flow rate of 1000 m3/h at the secondary underground exhaust duct bank.

information_points.content:
PROT-BLAST-JV7：Measured during the 24-hour continuous endurance window, Saltspray Salt Cavern Secure Facility satisfies verified impermeable vault containment sealing across inner containment boundary gasket assemblies under 50 Pa static differential pressure and sustains an auxiliary exhaust purge flow rate of 1200 m3/h.
PROT-BLAST-SOQ：Recorded over the 24-hour continuous endurance window, Highland Valley Engineered Bunker Complex does not meet verified impermeable vault containment sealing standards under 50 Pa static differential pressure, while maintaining an auxiliary exhaust purge flow rate of 1000 m3/h.
